content.value_statement: Paid search exports hide converting queries and waste patterns across many rows. This skill turns them into keyword adds, negative keywords, n-gram waste findings, and a maintenance diff.
actual_capabilities: Checks required search term columns before analysis.
Harvests converting queries for keyword or ad group additions.
Builds negative keyword recommendations for wasted queries.
Ranks 1-, 2-, and 3-gram waste by measured cost.
Produces add, negate, and move rows for maintenance.
Scores the ROAS spend-efficiency dimension with notes.
limitations: Requires a search terms export with cost and conversion columns.
Does not design account structure or allocate budgets.
Does not compute a complete RQS score.
API connectors are optional and depend on host configuration.

use_cases.title: Clean Weekly Search Terms
use_cases.description: Review a fresh export, identify wasted spend, and prepare negative keyword actions for the next optimization cycle.

use_cases.title: Find Converting Keyword Themes
use_cases.description: Turn queries with conversions into keyword or ad group additions without rebuilding the full account.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Maintenance Diffs
use_cases.description: Create add, negate, and move recommendations with measured cost notes for client review.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Negative Keyword List
prompt_templates.prompt: Mine this search terms export for wasted queries. Goal is direct response. Build a negative keyword list with cost evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Harvest Converting Queries
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this search terms export with conversions. Identify queries that should become keywords or ad group additions, and explain each route.

prompt_templates.title: N-Gram Waste Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze non-converting queries in this export. Rank 1-, 2-, and 3-gram waste by measured cost and recommend shared-list negatives.

prompt_templates.title: Full Maintenance Diff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete search term maintenance diff. Include add, negate, and move rows, an n-gram waste report, and ROAS S notes.

output_examples.input: A direct response search terms export with query, cost, clicks, conversions, and conversion value.
output_examples.output: The skill returns keyword additions, negative keyword recommendations, measured waste notes, and a spend-efficiency summary.

output_examples.input: A monthly export where many queries spent money but produced zero conversions.
output_examples.output: The skill ranks recurring waste tokens, proposes exact or phrase negatives, and states the cost floor used.

output_examples.input: A search terms export with several converting queries not yet present as keywords.
output_examples.output: The skill routes each converting query to add, move, or review, then prepares a concise handoff summary.

best_practices: Use a recent export that includes cost, conversions, and conversion value when available.
Set clear harvest and cost-floor thresholds before applying recommendations.
Review shared-list negatives before applying them across campaigns.
anti_patterns: Applying broad negatives without checking search intent.
Treating the output as a full account restructure.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a search terms export with query, cost, and conversions. Conversion value is useful for ROAS scoring.

faq.question: Can it build a full campaign structure?
faq.answer: No. It only creates maintenance recommendations for search terms, keywords, negatives, and spend-efficiency notes.

faq.question: Does it require an ad platform API?
faq.answer: No. A manual export or pasted table is enough. API connectors are optional host conveniences.

faq.question: How does it choose negative keywords?
faq.answer: It looks for queries or repeated tokens with meaningful spend and zero conversions, then suggests match type and level.

faq.question: Can it score ROAS performance?
faq.answer: It scores the spend-efficiency dimension it touches. It does not compute the full RQS score.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
